customManagers.description: Track seqeralabs/wave GitHub releases via the wave subchart's appVersion

packageRules.description: Do not bump the MySQL wait-for init container image. Platform requires MySQL 8.4 (see PR #188); newer major versions are unsupported.
New wave releases (https://github.com/seqeralabs/wave/releases) always bump the wave subchart's appVersion as a patch-level change for this repo, regardless of wave's own semver bump type.
prBodyNotes:
**Reviewer action required** before merging this PR:
- [ ] Add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `charts/platform/charts/wave/` describing the wave image bump.
- [ ] Add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `charts/platform/` noting the patch bump and the wave dependency update.
- [ ] Run `make -C charts/platform/ rebuild-deps-force` locally, commit and push the result to this branch (regenerates `Chart.lock` and the `README.md` files).
